convention: tay_trai/tay_phai, chan_trai/chan_phai theo phia nhan vat (nhan vat nhin ra man hinh). z: so thap = ve sau (sau), so cao = ve truoc. pivot: [x,y] theo toa do canvas goc.

parts.name: phu_kien_hieu_ung
parts.note: Vet sang trang duoi chan (hieu ung nen). z thap nhat, co dinh theo vi tri dung.

parts.name: chan_trai
parts.note: Chan trai NV (phai anh), giay den. Pivot hong. Di lai: xoay quanh hong.

parts.name: chan_phai
parts.note: Chan phai NV (trai anh), giay den. Pivot hong. Di lai: xoay quanh hong.

parts.name: than
parts.note: Long bao vang tu vai den chan. Pivot giua nguc. Cui chao: xoay nhe quanh than.

parts.name: phu_kien_gay
parts.note: Gay tre + ho lo. Pivot diem tay nam. Lac nhe khi di.

parts.name: tay_trai
parts.note: Tay trai NV (phai anh) cam gay. Pivot vai.

parts.name: tay_phai
parts.note: Tay phai NV (trai anh) trong tay ao rong. Pivot vai. Vay chao: xoay quanh vai.

parts.name: dau
parts.note: Mat + rau de. Pivot co. Gat/lac dau: xoay quanh co.

parts.name: phu_kien_mu
parts.note: Mu quan den. Pivot dinh dau. Nghieng theo dau.
